title: The guard's back
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Thursday, after the shop. Wood drives to Newport for no reason and the guard is back from the marina, tanned, at the Datsun's window before it's stopped. 'Lot C's for students.' 'Sort of.' 'Sort of.' Neither has changed the line. Neither wants to.

panels.composition: Lot C, evening. The GUARD, tanned, at the Datsun's window as it rolls in. WOOD. BARNABY.

image.prompt: a tanned security guard at a small car's window as it pulls into a college lot in the evening, a young man driving, a small dog on the seat, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The guard's hand on the roof. The pat.

image.prompt: close on a security guard's hand resting on a small car's roof, black and white, no words
a young man in a car, dry, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The guard walking off. The car in its spot. The dog. The line, unchanged, both ways. The strip has a line with the guard and it's a year old.
